text: Published in ACS Nano (carborane-thiolated Cu4 clusters for CO2-to-methane) and Chemistry of Materials (p-block-doped NiFe LDHs for AEM water electrolysis).
Our paper on cross-property transfer learning and generative crystal design for low thermal conductivity is out in ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces.
Joined the Materialyze.AI Lab at NUS (Prof. Shyue Ping Ong) as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, working on the AI Foundry.
Received the VPP Menon Gold Medal from IIT Indore for the outstanding Ph.D. dissertation by a female student; Ph.D. conferred.
Zn–ORR/CER battery with an iron-based MOF, with collaborators at IIT Ropar and Khalifa University, published in Energy & Environmental Science.
Fine-tuned universal potentials and lone-pair bonding descriptors for thermal conductivity published in Journal of Materials Chemistry A.
